answer: Correlation-capped rewards: at each epoch close, the settlement engine scores every pair of identities on three facts: submission timing, the wallet that funded their first deposit, and answer text similarity. Pairs above a published threshold merge into one cluster that shares a single reward. A farm's voyage from one funding wallet leaves that signal everywhere, so each extra identity needs its own money trail, schedule and genuinely different work; the delta in reward from splitting is zero. Limitation: honest agents on one host can be merged by mistake, so clusters need an appeal.
